title: From request to review
description: Follow a read-only template review in Claude. Ask for the candidate pool, watch the request run, then inspect the returned evidence.

source.attribution: Adapted from your supplied Webflow demo. Screen region cropped; opening and closing cards removed. Original recording preserved.

scenes.label: Ask
scenes.title: Give the work a boundary.
scenes.prompt: Show the November featured-template candidates. Include eligibility, readiness warnings, and category mix. Read only: no picks, votes, or changes.
scenes.evidence: The recorded request names the desired result and limits the action to reading.

scenes.label: Inspect
scenes.title: Follow the request.
scenes.prompt: Watch the request run. Keep the read-only boundary in view while Claude checks the candidate pool.
scenes.evidence: The recording shows Claude processing the request. It does not expose every underlying API operation.

scenes.label: Review
scenes.title: Read the result before acting.
scenes.prompt: Review the reported 23 eligible templates, readiness warnings, category mix, and creator repetition before making selections.
scenes.evidence: The recorded response reports 23 eligible templates and no readiness warnings. This is recorded evidence, not a fresh data check.
